request: In Streak, Cmd+J (the command toggleTheme, a Lisp function in the program's habits.lisp) should also show the toast "Theme changed", with the program's own toast function.

set./program/habits.lisp/toggleTheme:
(defcommand toggleTheme "Between light and dark."
  :title ~(t "action.toggleTheme.title") :category "Streak" :icon "moon"
  []
  (set "state.theme" (if (= computed.theme "light") "dark" "light"))
  (toast "Theme changed"))
